data.body_html:
Planning a Cabopino boat rental family day in 2045? You're in for a treat. Picture this: gentle waves, the Sierra Blanca behind you, and the kids laughing as they try their first paddleboard stand-up. We make it easy — our boats depart from Puerto Banús, just 15 minutes east of Cabopino, and we can arrange a pickup right at Cabopino marina. Whether you're after a 2-hour taster or a full-day adventure, we've got the right boat and the right gear.

Why Cabopino is the Perfect Family Base

Cabopino is a quiet, family-friendly marina with a sandy beach and a protected natural park. The waters here are calmer than around Marbella's Golden Mile, making it ideal for paddleboarding and snorkeling with children. In 2045, the sea breeze is still gentle, and the water temperature in June hovers around 22°C — perfect for a splash. You can anchor near Cabopino's dunes or head slightly west to the coves of Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, both known for clear, shallow water and abundant marine life.

Our Boats for Family Charters

We have a fleet of boats that suit different family sizes and budgets. For a small family of four or five, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) is a nimble choice. If you have up to nine guests, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) offers a spacious deck and a comfortable saloon. The Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) is another great option with a bit more room. For a truly luxurious day, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) comes with a free jet ski and a minimum 4-hour charter.

Paddleboarding and Snorkeling: What to Expect

Paddleboarding is a fantastic family activity — it's easy to learn, and kids pick it up quickly. We can provide paddleboards (for a small fee) and snorkel gear on request. The best spots are just a short cruise from Cabopino: Cala del Faro has rocky reefs teeming with fish, while Cala Cortés offers sheltered coves with sandy bottoms. For a more adventurous day, head to the Marbella coastline and explore the coves near Río Verde. All our skippers know the best spots for the day's conditions.

What's Included in Every Charter

Every one of our charters includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). That means no hidden costs — you just show up and enjoy. For paddleboards and snorkel gear, we'll add them to your booking for a small extra fee. Just let us know when you reserve via WhatsApp.

Pricing for 2045

Our Tier A boats — the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 — are priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. This includes everything mentioned above. For the Mangusta 80 (including the grey variant), the price is €4,719 for a 4-hour minimum, and a jet ski is included free. All other boats in our fleet are priced on request — just message us on WhatsApp for a quote tailored to your family's needs.

Sample Family Itinerary (6 Hours)

Here's a realistic plan for a 6-hour family day from Cabopino:

  • 10:00 — Board at Cabopino (or Puerto Banús) and meet your skipper.
  • 10:30 — Cruise along the coast to Cala del Faro, about 15 minutes away.
  • 11:00 — Anchor and snorkel in the clear, shallow water.
  • 12:00 — Paddleboarding session in the sheltered bay.
  • 13:00 — Enjoy a light snack and drinks on board.
  • 14:00 — Move to Cala Cortés for a second swim stop.
  • 15:30 — Cruise back to Cabopino, with a dolphin watch if you're lucky.
  • 16:00 — Disembark, tired and happy.

How to Book Your Family Day

Booking is simple: visit our [main page](/) to browse the fleet, then send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, boat, and any extras like paddleboards. We'll confirm availability and send you all the details. For a full list of our boats, check out our [fleet overview](/) — and if you're still deciding, our [Marbella boat rental guide](/blog/marbella-boat-rental-guide/) has more tips.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can we depart from Cabopino instead of Puerto Banús?

Yes, we can arrange a Cabopino pickup on request. Our boats are based in Puerto Banús, but for family convenience we often meet guests at Cabopino's marina. Just message us on WhatsApp with your preferred time and we'll confirm availability.

Which boat is best for a family day with paddleboarding and snorkeling?

For a small family, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) is nimble and easy. For larger groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) offer space and comfort. All can carry paddleboards and snorkel gear on request.

Is paddleboarding gear included in the charter price?

Paddleboards and snorkel equipment are not included in the standard charter, but we can add them for a small fee. Let us know when booking and we'll have them ready on board. The base charter always includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA.

What are the best snorkeling spots near Cabopino?

Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés are two of the best. Cala del Faro has rocky reefs with plenty of fish, while Cala Cortés offers sheltered coves. Both are within a short boat ride from Cabopino and have clear, calm water ideal for children.

How long should we charter for a family day?

For a relaxed day with paddleboarding and snorkeling, we recommend at least 4 hours. This gives you time to cruise to a snorkeling spot, spend an hour in the water, have a snack, and move to a second location. If you want to visit Cabopino and back, 6–8 hours is ideal.

What is the cost for a family charter from Cabopino?

For our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. This includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. Larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for a 4-hour minimum. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Do we need to bring our own snorkeling equipment?

No, we can provide snorkel masks, fins, and paddleboards for an additional fee. Just mention your needs when booking. If you prefer to bring your own, that's fine too — there's plenty of storage on all our boats.

What should we wear for paddleboarding in 2045?

In 2045, expect water temperatures around 22°C in June and air temps up to 30°C. A wetsuit is optional but recommended for early mornings. Don't forget reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and a rash guard. We provide fresh water to rinse off after your swim.
